dedupe_keys.name: dataset for integrated sensing and communication dataset employing leaky wave antenna

description: Universidad Politécnica de Cartagena researchers publish anechoic-chamber and indoor measurements for a 5 GHz Wi-Fi sensing and communication system. The April 2026 Zenodo release provides two data archives under CC BY 4.0, with linked Python and MATLAB acquisition and analysis repositories using the same stated terms. Records contain timestamps, two RSSI values, transmit and receive bitrates and MCS indices, throughput, channel, bandwidth and antenna angle. Chamber sweeps cover minus ninety-five to plus ninety-five degrees; the documented indoor comparison uses seven positions and leaky-wave, panel and monopole antennas. These observations can calibrate localisation and communication-performance simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the package. Site geometry, observation dates and broader deployment representativeness remain uncertain. Reproduction requires the documented hardware or archived data and MATLAB; the optimisation scripts compare channel/sample reductions without new measurements. Reported accuracy and acquisition-time results were not independently tested.
